fusions.name: Brought to Bay
fusions.desc: A clamping bite of spiked metal that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Slipped Leash
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Collar of Spikes
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each attacker is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Junkyard Mastiff
fusions.desc: Calls a mastiff that fights beside you, biting an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing what it bites by 20% for 2 seconds.
